meta.title: Wetherspoons Plymouth: pubs, menu and prices guide
meta.description: Compare Wetherspoons Plymouth pubs across Union Street, Barbican, Milehouse and Plympton. Find your nearest option and learn how to check menu prices.

intro:
This guide covers {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Plymouth across {areaCount} areas, helping you choose a location, compare menu prices and plan breakfast or a club visit. Every pub works from the national [Wetherspoons menu](/), but prices are set locally. Find The Union Rooms, The Gog and Magog, The Britannia Inn and The Stannary Court below, with practical advice on checking what each pub charges before ordering.

SpoonsMenu is an independent guide, not affiliated with J D Wetherspoon plc.
quickAnswer: We list {pubCount} open Wetherspoons pubs in Plymouth across {areaCount} areas: The Union Rooms on Union Street, The Gog and Magog in the Barbican, The Britannia Inn in Milehouse and The Stannary Court in Plympton. Choose the area that suits your plans, then check that pub’s menu prices rather than assuming every location charges the same.

areas.text: The Union Rooms is the listed Wetherspoons on Union Street in Plymouth. It suits visitors whose plans already bring them to this area and who want to order from the broadly national menu. Check the pub’s own prices before choosing between breakfast, a burger or another meal.

The Gog and Magog is the listed Wetherspoons in the Barbican, with an address on Southside Street. It is a practical choice if this area fits your visit. Use the pub’s menu to check current prices and availability rather than relying on what you paid at another Wetherspoons.

The Britannia Inn is the listed Wetherspoons in Milehouse, on Wolseley Road. It suits people looking for a pub in this area rather than choosing solely by menu, since the food range is broadly shared nationally. Compare its current prices with another location if cost is your main concern.

The Stannary Court is the listed Wetherspoons in Plympton, with an address on Ridgeway. Choose it if Plympton is the area that works for your plans. For a breakfast or club visit, check serving times and participation with the pub before making a special trip.

pricing:
Wetherspoons menu prices in Plymouth vary by pub, even though the menu is broadly the same nationally. Popular national choices include traditional [breakfast](/breakfast-menu), [burgers](/burgers), curries, fish and chips, and pizza. A familiar dish does not mean a familiar bill: each pub sets its own prices.

City centre pubs often charge more than suburban pubs, so location can affect the comparison. That general pattern does not establish which Plymouth pub is cheapest, and any quoted price should be treated as typical rather than fixed.

For the exact price, check the menu for your chosen pub in the Wetherspoon app or ask at the bar before ordering. Compare the same dish across locations to make the comparison useful.
breakfastAndClubs:
Breakfast at Wetherspoons is typically served from eight am until midday, while [Curry Club](/curry-club) is traditionally on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs. These are general timings and club days, not confirmation of the arrangements at every Plymouth location.

The traditional breakfast is among the popular dishes on the national menu. If breakfast or a particular club is the reason for your visit, check serving times, participation and the current menu with your chosen pub first. Pub opening hours should be checked separately rather than inferred from the breakfast window.
